records.generatedCopy:
Anthropic now exposes saved Claude and Cowork user instructions through the Compliance API beta. That helps compliance teams audit durable preferences, but it can also create a second sensitive-data store if the rollout is careless.

Use a hash-first inventory, preserve membership changes during pagination, gate plaintext review, delete temporary exports, and keep receipts for every access. The guide also separates API acceptance from audit completeness and keeps Jev-style performance claims out of the evidence boundary.

Read the bilingual rollout checklist:
